priority_actions: Fix the CTR leak first: add compelling meta titles/descriptions plus CTAs and internal links from the sleep post (2,234 imp, 0 clicks) and the GLP-1 medications page (907 imp, 0 clicks, pos 9.8) into the matching service pages — this is the fastest path to more clicks with zero new rankings needed.

Keyword-tracker hygiene: repoint the 1 remaining staging targetUrl in keywords-master.json to its live www URL so GSC page matching works; if a staging->prod publish backlog matters, confirm the real push list via a staging-vs-prod sitemap diff or Daniel's notes rather than inferring a count from keyword data.

Defend the core bariatric head terms (#1-#10 cluster: bariatric therapy / counseling / counselor / surgery counseling / therapist) with fresh internal links and FAQ schema on their target pages for rich-result and AI-overview eligibility.

Chase discovery wins already near page 1: dehydration-weight-loss queries at position ~2-3 (120+ combined impressions) and the Ozempic/Mounjaro/Zepbound comparison cluster at ~10 — small on-page tweaks plus schema could convert these to clicks.
summary: Core bariatric commercial terms keep climbing (bariatric counseling 4.1, near-me #3) and clicks are up 2 to 14 daily, but overall impressions are down ~30% since early May and high-impression blog pages are converting at near-zero CTR; 17 of 83 tracked keywords (a keyword count, not pages) currently show GSC data.
